description: This file defines an interface 'ExpiringValue' which represents a generic value with a limited validity period, providing methods to retrieve the value and check expiration status based on system time or a specified instant.

classes.name: ExpiringValue
classes.description: A generic interface representing a value that has an expiration condition, with methods to retrieve the value and check if it has expired.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the current value of the object.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Determines whether the value has expired based on the current system time.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if the value has expired relative to a specific reference instant.
